title: Nehemiah Chapter 10 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Nehemiah chapter 10 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Nehemiah Chapter 10 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Nehemiah Chapter 10.

questions.question: In Nehemiah 10, which of the following appears FIRST in the chapter?
options: Nehemiah, the Tirshatha, the son of Hachaliah
questions.correctAnswer: Nehemiah, the Tirshatha, the son of Hachaliah
questions.explanation: Nehemiah, the Tirshatha, the son of Hachaliah, is mentioned first in Nehemiah 10:1.

questions.question: Which of the following was NOT listed among those who sealed the document in Nehemiah 10:1?
questions.explanation: Jeshua is mentioned later as a Levite in Nehemiah 10:9, not among those who sealed in Nehemiah 10:1.

questions.question: Who is listed among the priests that sealed the covenant in Nehemiah 10:8?
questions.explanation: Maaziah is listed among the priests who sealed the covenant in Nehemiah 10:8.

questions.question: According to Nehemiah 10:9, who among these was a Levite?
questions.explanation: Jeshua the son of Azaniah is named as a Levite in Nehemiah 10:9.

questions.question: Which of the following names appears in Nehemiah 10:3?
questions.explanation: Malchijah is mentioned in Nehemiah 10:3 among those who sealed the covenant.

questions.question: Who is mentioned in Nehemiah 10:6 among those who sealed the document?
questions.explanation: Daniel is listed in Nehemiah 10:6 among those who sealed the covenant.

questions.question: Which of the following individuals is identified as a priest in Nehemiah 10:8?
questions.explanation: Shemaiah is named among the priests who sealed the covenant in Nehemiah 10:8.

questions.question: According to Nehemiah 10:10, who is listed among the brethren of the Levites?
questions.explanation: Shebaniah is mentioned as one of the brethren of the Levites in Nehemiah 10:10.

questions.question: Which name appears in Nehemiah 10:11?
questions.explanation: Micha is listed among those who sealed the covenant in Nehemiah 10:11.

questions.question: Who is mentioned in Nehemiah 10:12?
questions.explanation: Sherebiah is named among those who sealed the covenant in Nehemiah 10:12.

questions.question: Who is listed last among those who sealed the covenant in Nehemiah 10:13?
questions.explanation: Beninu is the last name mentioned in Nehemiah 10:13 among those who sealed the covenant.

questions.question: True or False: Nehemiah is listed as one of the sealers of the covenant in chapter 10.
questions.explanation: Nehemiah is named first among those who sealed the covenant in Nehemiah 10:1.

questions.question: True or False: Jeshua the son of Azaniah is identified as a Levite in Nehemiah 10.
questions.explanation: Jeshua the son of Azaniah is specifically mentioned as a Levite in Nehemiah 10:9.

questions.question: True or False: The text states that Nehemiah was the son of Malchijah.
questions.explanation: Nehemiah is identified as the son of Hachaliah, not Malchijah, in Nehemiah 10:1.

questions.question: True or False: The text lists Ezra as one of those who sealed the covenant in chapter 10.
questions.explanation: Ezra is not mentioned anywhere in Nehemiah 10 as one who sealed the covenant.

medium.title: Nehemiah Chapter 10 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Nehemiah Chapter 10 to real-life situations.

questions.question: Which of the following was NOT listed among the chief of the people in Nehemiah 10:14-26?
questions.explanation: David is not listed among the chiefs in Nehemiah 10:14-26, unlike Parosh, Elam, and Zatthu.

questions.question: What does Nehemiah 10:15 promise will happen if someone follows the commitment made in Nehemiah 10:14?
options: They will be blessed by God
They will prosper in the land
They will be counted among the people
The land will rest from its sabbaths
questions.correctAnswer: They will be counted among the people
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:15 follows the listing of chiefs in verse 14 and implies those who sealed the covenant are counted among the people, showing their commitment.

questions.question: Which tribe does Adonijah, mentioned in Nehemiah 10:16, belong to based on the context of the chapter?
questions.explanation: Adonijah is listed among the chief leaders of the people in Nehemiah 10:16, not among priests or Levites.

questions.question: How are the names in Nehemiah 10:20-21 connected to those in 10:22-23?
options: Both groups are from priestly families
Both groups include chief leaders who sealed the covenant
The first group are Levites, the second are priests
The groups represent different tribes of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: Both groups include chief leaders who sealed the covenant
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:20-23 lists chief leaders from different families who sealed the covenant, showing unity in commitment.

questions.question: What practical Christian principle can be drawn from the commitment of so many leaders sealing the covenant in Nehemiah 10:14-26?
options: Leadership requires public commitment and accountability
Only priests need to commit to God's laws
Private faith is sufficient without public action
Leaders should remain silent about their beliefs
questions.correctAnswer: Leadership requires public commitment and accountability
questions.explanation: The leaders publicly sealed the covenant, demonstrating accountability and leadership in faith as seen in Nehemiah 10:14-26.

questions.question: Considering Nehemiah 10:24-25, what does the detailed listing of names suggest about the community's approach to obedience?
options: Collective responsibility in obeying the covenant
Only a few individuals are responsible
Names are listed for genealogical purposes only
questions.correctAnswer: Collective responsibility in obeying the covenant
questions.explanation: The detailed list shows that many leaders took collective responsibility for the covenant's observance (Nehemiah 10:24-25).

questions.question: How does the naming of priests and Levites in earlier verses (Nehemiah 10:8-13) complement the listing of chiefs in verses 14-26?
options: It shows unity across different societal roles
It lists only religious roles without lay leaders
questions.correctAnswer: It shows unity across different societal roles
questions.explanation: The priests, Levites, and chiefs all sealed the covenant, demonstrating unity in commitment across roles (Nehemiah 10:8-26).

questions.question: What can modern Christians learn about integrity from the detailed covenant sealing in Nehemiah 10?
options: Integrity is less important than ritual
questions.explanation: The leaders publicly sealed the covenant, showing integrity through transparency and accountability (Nehemiah 10:1-26).

questions.question: Why might the community have recorded so many names in the covenant as in Nehemiah 10:14-26?
options: To inflate the size of the community
To exclude others from the covenant
To comply with a royal decree
questions.explanation: Listing names creates a record of those responsible for the covenant, promoting accountability (Nehemiah 10:14-26).

questions.question: How does the covenant in Nehemiah 10 demonstrate practical obedience to God’s commandments?
options: By committing leaders to uphold laws and support the temple
By focusing solely on temple rituals
By prioritizing individual over communal faith
questions.correctAnswer: By committing leaders to uphold laws and support the temple
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10 shows leaders pledging to obey God's laws and support temple functions, practical obedience in community life.

questions.question: What role do the Levites and priests listed in Nehemiah 10:8-13 play in the context of the covenant made by the chiefs in 10:14-26?
options: They support the spiritual leadership and enforcement of the covenant
They are excluded from the covenant
questions.correctAnswer: They support the spiritual leadership and enforcement of the covenant
questions.explanation: Levites and priests bear spiritual responsibility, helping enforce the covenant alongside chiefs (Nehemiah 10:8-26).

questions.question: In terms of prayer and faith, what does the act of sealing the covenant in Nehemiah 10 symbolize?
options: A solemn, communal commitment to God’s law
A political alliance without religious significance
questions.correctAnswer: A solemn, communal commitment to God’s law
questions.explanation: Sealing the covenant publicly reflects serious, communal dedication to obeying God (Nehemiah 10:1-26).

questions.question: True or False: The names listed in Nehemiah 10:14-26 include only priests and Levites.
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:14-26 lists chief leaders of the people, not just priests and Levites.

questions.question: True or False: Nehemiah and the priests named in Nehemiah 10:1-8 were among those who sealed the covenant.
questions.explanation: Nehemiah and the priests listed in verses 1-8 sealed the covenant as stated in Nehemiah 10:1-8.

questions.question: True or False: The covenant sealing in Nehemiah 10 was a private matter only for a few select leaders.
questions.explanation: The covenant involved many leaders and representatives, showing a public, communal act (Nehemiah 10:1-26).

hard.title: Nehemiah Chapter 10 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Nehemiah Chapter 10.

questions.question: Who were the individuals mentioned at the end of Nehemiah 10?
questions.explanation: The individuals mentioned at the end of Nehemiah 10 are specifically noted in Nehemiah 10:27.

questions.question: What did the people agree to do regarding their daughters in Nehemiah 10?
options: Give their daughters to the people of the land
Not give their daughters unto the people of the land
Take daughters from the people of the land
questions.correctAnswer: Not give their daughters unto the people of the land
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:30 explicitly states that they agreed not to give their daughters to the people of the land.

questions.question: What did the people of Israel agree not to do on the Sabbath according to Nehemiah 10?
options: Buy goods from the people of the land
Sell goods to the people of the land
questions.correctAnswer: Buy goods from the people of the land
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:31 states that they agreed not to buy on the Sabbath or on holy days.

questions.question: What was the yearly charge agreed upon by the people for the service of the house of God?
options: A third part of a shekel
questions.correctAnswer: A third part of a shekel
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:32 mentions that they charged themselves yearly with the third part of a shekel for the service of the house of God.

questions.question: Which offerings were the people required to bring to the house of God?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:37 specifically details that they were to bring firstfruits and tithes to the house of God.

questions.question: What is the significance of the term 'Nethinims' in Nehemiah 10:28?
questions.explanation: The term 'Nethinims' refers to the temple servants, as understood in the historical context of the temple service.

questions.question: What does the Hebrew word 'shekel' in Nehemiah 10:32 mean?
questions.explanation: The Hebrew word for 'shekel' refers to a coin, serving as a unit of currency during the time.

questions.question: Which literary technique is exemplified in Nehemiah 10:29 where the people enter into a curse and an oath?
questions.explanation: The use of a curse and an oath as bookends to their commitment indicates inclusio, framing the seriousness of their vow.

questions.question: Which other Bible passage connects to the theme of not intermarrying with foreign peoples as seen in Nehemiah 10:30?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 7:3 advises against intermarriage with foreign peoples, echoing the commitment made in Nehemiah 10:30.

questions.question: Which other Bible passage emphasizes the importance of tithing, similar to Nehemiah 10:37?
questions.explanation: Malachi 3:10 emphasizes the importance of bringing tithes into the storehouse, paralleling the commitment in Nehemiah 10:37.

questions.question: What comes immediately before Nehemiah 10:30?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:30 follows directly after Nehemiah 10:29, which discusses the people's commitment to God's law.

questions.question: Which of the following is true about the people’s commitment in Nehemiah 10:29?
options: They entered into a curse and an oath
questions.correctAnswer: They entered into a curse and an oath
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:29 explicitly states that they entered into a curse and an oath to follow God's law.

questions.question: The offerings mentioned in Nehemiah 10:33 are intended to make atonement for whom?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:33 indicates that the offerings were to make atonement for Israel, highlighting their collective responsibility.

questions.question: True or False: The people of Israel agreed to leave the exaction of every debt as stated in Nehemiah 10:31.
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:31 states that they agreed to leave the exaction of every debt, emphasizing their commitment to the law.

questions.question: True or False: Nehemiah 10:38 states that the Levites shall not bring up the tithe of the tithes to the house of God.
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:38 clearly states that the Levites shall bring up the tithe of the tithes to the house of God, affirming their duties.

theological.title: Nehemiah Chapter 10 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Nehemiah Chapter 10 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What doctrine does Nehemiah 10:29 teach about sanctification?
options: Sanctification involves a covenantal commitment to walk in God's law and observe His commandments
Sanctification is solely an individual, internal experience without public accountability
Sanctification is achieved by works without reliance on God's grace
Sanctification means complete sinlessness in this life without struggle
questions.correctAnswer: Sanctification involves a covenantal commitment to walk in God's law and observe His commandments
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:29 emphasizes entering into a curse and oath to walk in God's law and observe all His commandments, showing sanctification as a covenantal, communal commitment to holiness.

questions.question: What doctrine about God's covenant faithfulness is taught in Nehemiah 10:32?
options: God's covenant requires continual obedience and provision for the temple service
God's covenant is unconditional and requires no human participation
God's covenant is limited to the Old Testament era and not relevant here
God's covenant is primarily about national political power
questions.correctAnswer: God's covenant requires continual obedience and provision for the temple service
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:32 shows the people charging themselves yearly with a third of a shekel for temple service, reflecting ongoing obedience and covenant responsibility.

questions.question: What doctrine regarding separation and holiness is conveyed in Nehemiah 10:30?
options: God's people must separate themselves from foreign influences through marriage to maintain holiness
Holiness is achieved by cultural assimilation and intermarriage
Separation from non-believers is unnecessary for covenant faithfulness
Holiness is only about individual piety, not community boundaries
questions.correctAnswer: God's people must separate themselves from foreign influences through marriage to maintain holiness
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:30 forbids giving daughters to or taking daughters from the people of the land, underscoring separation as key to covenant holiness.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does Nehemiah 10:33 specifically demonstrate?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:33 outlines detailed ordinances for temple offerings and sacrifices, demonstrating God's covenant faithfulness in providing a structured means for atonement and worship.

questions.question: Which divine attribute is highlighted in Nehemiah 10:38 by the cooperation of priests and Levites in tithing?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:38 shows the priests and Levites jointly managing tithes and offerings, reflecting the divine attribute of holiness in maintaining pure worship.

questions.question: How does Nehemiah 10:39 connect to the broader biblical theme of temple worship continuity?
options: It affirms the ongoing commitment to sustain the temple and its ministers as a center of covenant life
It rejects temple worship in favor of individual spirituality
It introduces a new form of worship unrelated to the Mosaic Law
It signals the end of sacrificial offerings in Israel
questions.correctAnswer: It affirms the ongoing commitment to sustain the temple and its ministers as a center of covenant life
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:39 emphasizes bringing offerings to the temple and supporting its ministers, reinforcing the biblical theme of covenantal worship continuity.

questions.question: How does the covenant renewal in Nehemiah 10:1-27 prepare for the Messianic hope in Scripture?
options: By reaffirming the law and communal holiness, it anticipates the Messiah who fulfills and perfects the covenant
By focusing on political restoration only, it denies spiritual restoration
By rejecting the law, it points away from Messiah
By emphasizing human effort without divine aid, it denies grace
questions.correctAnswer: By reaffirming the law and communal holiness, it anticipates the Messiah who fulfills and perfects the covenant
questions.explanation: The renewal covenant in Nehemiah 10 anticipates the Messiah who will fulfill the law and bring true restoration, connecting to redemptive history.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do verses Nehemiah 10:35 and Nehemiah 10:36 teach about firstfruits and dedication?
options: Firstfruits represent total dedication to God and acknowledgment of His sovereignty over all creation
Firstfruits are merely a cultural tradition without theological significance
Firstfruits symbolize human merit earning salvation
Firstfruits are optional and unrelated to covenant obedience
questions.correctAnswer: Firstfruits represent total dedication to God and acknowledgment of His sovereignty over all creation
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:35-36 require bringing firstfruits of produce and firstborn of sons and cattle to God, symbolizing full dedication and recognition of God's lordship.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Nehemiah 10:28 and Nehemiah 10:29 teach about obedience and community identity?
options: Obedience to God's law is both an individual and corporate commitment that defines Israel's identity
Obedience is only private and does not affect community
Community identity is independent of covenant obedience
Obedience is unrelated to covenant curses or oaths
questions.correctAnswer: Obedience to God's law is both an individual and corporate commitment that defines Israel's identity
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:28-29 shows the people and their families separating themselves to the law and entering a communal covenant, linking obedience with collective identity.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Nehemiah 10:31 and Nehemiah 10:32 teach about Sabbath observance and stewardship?
options: Sabbath observance requires active refusal to engage in commerce, coupled with responsible financial provision for temple worship
Sabbath is a flexible day without restrictions on commerce or offerings
Stewardship is unrelated to Sabbath observance
Sabbath laws are obsolete and abandoned
questions.correctAnswer: Sabbath observance requires active refusal to engage in commerce, coupled with responsible financial provision for temple worship
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:31 forbids buying on the Sabbath, and 10:32 establishes a yearly charge for temple service, teaching rest and stewardship as covenant obligations.

questions.question: Skeptics claim Nehemiah 10:30-31 promotes legalism and cultural exclusivism. What does Nehemiah 10:30-31 actually teach?
options: It teaches covenantal separation to preserve holiness and Sabbath observance as an expression of worship, not legalism
It encourages harsh ethnic discrimination that contradicts God's character
It abolishes the Sabbath and cultural distinctions
It permits syncretism and intermarriage without restrictions
questions.correctAnswer: It teaches covenantal separation to preserve holiness and Sabbath observance as an expression of worship, not legalism
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:30-31 emphasize separation and Sabbath rest to maintain covenant holiness, showing a theological purpose rather than arbitrary legalism.

questions.question: What doctrine about priestly mediation is taught in Nehemiah 10:38?
options: Priests mediate by overseeing tithes and offerings, ensuring covenant faithfulness and worship order
Priests have no role in material support or covenant mediation
Priestly mediation is only spiritual and excludes financial responsibilities
Priests are to be self-sufficient without communal support
questions.correctAnswer: Priests mediate by overseeing tithes and offerings, ensuring covenant faithfulness and worship order
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:38 describes priests working with Levites in collecting and managing tithes, revealing their mediating role in worship and covenant maintenance.

questions.question: Which divine attribute is revealed in Nehemiah 10:34 concerning the appointment of offerings by lot?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:34 shows the casting of lots among priests and Levites for offerings, demonstrating God's sovereign control over temple worship.

questions.question: How does the commitment recorded in Nehemiah 10:37-39 anticipate New Testament teachings on stewardship and worship?
options: It anticipates the principle of proportional giving and communal support of ministry found in the New Testament
It rejects any form of giving or communal support
It teaches salvation is earned by tithing
It makes worship dependent solely on ritual without heart involvement
questions.correctAnswer: It anticipates the principle of proportional giving and communal support of ministry found in the New Testament
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:37-39 require tithes and offerings to support priests and Levites, foreshadowing New Testament stewardship principles of proportional giving and church support.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Nehemiah 10:9 and Nehemiah 10:28 teach about the role of Levites and separated communities in covenant renewal?
options: Levites and the separated people serve as mediators and exemplars of covenant obedience within the community
Levites have no special function in the covenant community
Separated communities are excluded from covenant obligations
The Levites act independently without relation to the people
questions.correctAnswer: Levites and the separated people serve as mediators and exemplars of covenant obedience within the community
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 10:9 lists Levites among covenant signatories, and 10:28 highlights those separated to the law, showing their role as religious leaders and covenant exemplars.
